name: odoo-ai-agents
description: Odoo AI workforce toolkit - 47 skills + 20 specialist agents + 8 workflow commands across engineering, sales, marketing, strategy, setup, visual UI testing, and automated multi-module git integration. Pairs with the odoo-semantic-mcp server for indexed-codebase grounding (auto-installed). Includes browser-automation agents for Odoo UI review and automated setup.

interface.shortDescription: 51-skill AI workforce for Odoo ERP - engineering, sales, marketing & strategy.
interface.longDescription: A comprehensive AI workforce plugin for Odoo ERP practitioners. Provides 47 skills covering Odoo development (solution design, frontend design, coding, code review, frontend, testing, i18n translation, instance operations, visual documentation), consulting (gap analysis, upgrade planning, risk overview), sales/pre-sales (bid response, competitive briefs, deal follow-up), marketing (content drafting, campaign planning, feature highlights), and strategy (discovery, deployment checklists). Pairs with the odoo-semantic-mcp server for indexed-codebase grounding. Includes 20 specialist agents: the full-stack odoo-coder that owns one plan node from code to commit (tests inline, odoo-frontend-coder for a disjoint JS/OWL part), the read-only odoo-impact-recon, the three-mode odoo-code-reviewer and the two-mode odoo-qa-tester; browser-automation agents for Odoo UI review, visual regression testing, automated setup, and the single odoo-doc-writer for the user guide and the App Store page; forward-port pre-analysis agents for intent extraction and installable-state probing; and the odoo-instance-ops agent for end-to-end instance lifecycle management (create, drop, init, update, test) across Odoo v8+. Also bundles browser MCP servers (Chrome DevTools, Playwright, Pagecast) for rich UI interaction across Codex CLI and Gemini CLI.
